responsibility: Provides the generated documentation-link companion for the MSP430 target option table. For each option declared in msp430.opt, it maps the option name to the corresponding HTML manual anchor via UrlSuffix entries so GCC’s generated option metadata can refer users to the correct MSP430 options documentation. It contains no option semantics or backend logic itself; it is auxiliary generated data tied specifically to MSP430 option-help and diagnostics/documentation cross-references.
